senses.gloss:
m. (तुक्)
Offspring, children.
E.
तुज to guard, affix क्विप्.

r. 1st cl. (तोजति)
To kill or hurt.
(इ) तुजि r. 1st cl. (तुञ्जति)
To guard or protect.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (तुञ्जति तुञ्जयति)
1 To dwell, to abide.
2 To be strong or vigorous.
3 To give.
4 To hurt, to injure or kill.
5 To shine.
